explanation.explanation: Panel A is a 3D rendered segmentation/cartoon of a tomogram showing preconoidal rings and pellicular actin; it is not a quantitative plot with labeled axes, so axis units do not apply.
Panel B is a 3D rendered segmentation of the basal end of a sporozoite; it is a structural rendering, not a quantitative plot, so no axis units are required.
Panel C is a tomographic slice image with an embedded scale bar (100 nm), not a graph with quantitative axes; axis units do not apply.
Panel D is a 3D cartoon/rendering of a lateral section of the cell showing nuclear, cytosolic and pellicular actin; it is not a quantitative plot, so axis units do not apply.
Panel E is a tomographic average slice with an embedded scale bar (25 nm), not a graph with quantitative axes; axis units do not apply.
Panel F is a tomographic slice image with an embedded scale bar (50 nm), not a graph with quantitative axes; axis units do not apply.
